ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the sickness in the next town
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: Sickness spreads through a town near the colony. The colony is asked for medicine and to care for some of the sick, and how that goes decides what the town's people do next.

outcomes.li: [sick,outcome:harmed] one of the sick taken prisoner
[sick,outcome:declined] the colony did not take in the sick
[healer,outcome:fewlessons] {RIVAL} came, but there was time for only a few lessons
[healer,outcome:declined] the colony did not take in the healer
[kin,outcome:handed] the families took their dead home
[kin,outcome:buried] the dead buried at the colony
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:sick] The sickness at {PLACE} is not over yet.
[next:healer] {FACTION} want to thank the colony for caring for their sick.
[next:kin] {FACTION} will send word about their dead.
[end:thanked] {FACTION} want to thank the colony another way.

summaries.li: {FACTION} asked the colony for medicine when {KIND} spread through {PLACE}, and the colony said no.
{FACTION} asked the colony for medicine when {KIND} spread through {PLACE}, and the colony did not have it ready in time.
the colony sent medicine to {PLACE} when {KIND} spread there, but would not take in the sick.
the colony cared for the sick from {PLACE}, all of them recovered, and {FACTION} sent {RIVAL} to teach the colony's doctor.

texts.li: {FACTION} are grateful that the colony cared for their sick from {PLACE}. Someone of theirs has brought {SILVER} medicine to the colony's gate as a gift.

summaries.li: the colony cared for the sick from {PLACE}, all of them recovered, and {FACTION} sent the colony medicine in thanks.
some of the sick from {PLACE} died in the colony's care, and their families took the bodies home.
some of the sick from {PLACE} died in the colony's care, and they are buried at the colony.
some of the sick from {PLACE} died in the colony's care, and the colony would not let their families come for them.
some of the sick from {PLACE} died in the colony's care, and their bodies were gone when their families came.
the colony took in the sick from {PLACE} and then took one of them prisoner.

texts.li: [war] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and the colony will hear no more about the sickness at {PLACE}.
[destroyed] {FACTION} are gone, and the colony will hear no more about the sickness at {PLACE}.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony while {KIND} was still at {PLACE}.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone before the sickness at {PLACE} was over.
nothing more came of the sickness at {PLACE}.

ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the strayed herd
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: A herding people's animals stray onto the colony's land. The colony keeps them for the herders, then keeps part of the herd through a winter, and the herders come back for it in spring.

outcomes.li: [winter,outcome:kept] every animal kept alive and well
[winter,outcome:declined] the colony would not keep the animals
[spring,outcome:young] the herd taken home, and young animals left with the colony
[spring,outcome:bought] the colony bought the rest of the herd
[spring,outcome:unpaid] the colony would not pay for the dead animals
[spring,outcome:declined] the colony did not answer the herders
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:spring,winter] {FACTION}'s herders will come for their {KIND} now that winter is over.

summaries.li: {FACTION}'s {KIND} strayed onto the colony's land, and the colony would not keep them.
{FACTION}'s {KIND} strayed onto the colony's land, and most of them were lost while the colony kept them.
the colony kept {FACTION}'s strayed {KIND} for them, but would not keep part of their herd for a season.
[winter] the colony kept part of {FACTION}'s herd through the winter, and in spring the herders left it young animals in thanks.
[!winter] the colony kept part of {FACTION}'s herd for a season, and the herders left it young animals in thanks.
some of the {KIND} the colony kept for {FACTION} died, and the colony paid for them.
some of the {KIND} the colony kept for {FACTION} died, and the colony bought the ones that were left.
some of the {KIND} the colony kept for {FACTION} died, and the colony would not pay for them.

texts.li: The colony did not answer {FACTION}'s herders, so they came for their {KIND} anyway and took them home. They left nothing for the keeping.

summaries.li: the colony kept part of {FACTION}'s herd, and the herders took it home without a word from the colony.

texts.li: [war,ours] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, so nobody will come for their {KIND}. The animals the colony was keeping are its own now.
[destroyed,ours] {FACTION} are gone, so nobody will come for their {KIND}. The animals the colony was keeping are its own now.
[war,!ours] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and their herders' business with the colony is over.
[destroyed,!ours] {FACTION} are gone, and their herders' business with the colony is over.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony while it was keeping their {KIND}.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone before their herders came back.
nothing more came of {FACTION}'s strayed {KIND}.

ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the pilgrims' relic
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: Pilgrims carrying a relic rest at the colony, and in the night it is stolen. What the colony does about the thief decides whether the relic comes back, and where it stays.

outcomes.li: [rest,outcome:handed] the thief caught and handed to the pilgrims
[rest,outcome:punished] the thief caught and kept prisoner
[rest,outcome:letgo] the thief caught and let go
[rest,outcome:killed] the thief killed, and the relic back
[rest,outcome:dropped] the thief gone without the relic
[rest,outcome:escaped] the thief got away with the relic
[shrine,outcome:kept] the relic left at the colony's shrine
[shrine,outcome:declined] the colony would not keep the relic
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:trail] {FACTION} are deciding what to do about their stolen relic.
[next:shrine] {GIVER} of {FACTION} wants to ask the colony something about the relic.

summaries.li: pilgrims of {FACTION} with a relic asked to rest at the colony, and the colony said no.
pilgrims of {FACTION} rested at the colony with their relic, and came to harm there.
{RIVAL} stole the relic of {FACTION}'s pilgrims while they rested at the colony, and it was never found.
the relic of {FACTION}'s pilgrims was stolen at the colony and came back to them, and they took it home.
the relic of {FACTION}'s pilgrims was stolen at the colony and came back to them, and they left it at the colony's shrine for a year.

texts.li: [war,ours] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, so their pilgrims will not come back for the relic. It stays with the colony.
[destroyed,ours] {FACTION} are gone, so nobody will come back for the relic. It stays with the colony.
[war,!ours] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and their pilgrims will not come back.
[destroyed,!ours] {FACTION} are gone, and their pilgrims will not come back.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony before the matter of the relic was settled.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone before the matter of the relic was settled.
nothing more came of the relic of {FACTION}'s pilgrims.

ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: two towns' quarrel
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: Two peoples on bad terms with each other make a truce at the colony. Not everyone keeps to it, and the colony's choice decides whether the peace holds.

outcomes.li: [truce,outcome:witnessed] the truce made at the colony
[truce,outcome:missed] nobody came to witness the truce
[pledge,outcome:declined] the colony would not keep the pledge
[fighters,outcome:stopped] the fighters stopped at the gate
[fighters,outcome:fought] the fighters fought off at the gate
[fighters,outcome:declined] the colony stayed out of it
[outcome:gone] ended when one of the two turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:pledge] {FACTION} want to show {OTHERPEOPLE} that they mean to keep the truce.
[next:fighters] Not all of {OTHERPEOPLE} agree with the truce.
[end:war] The fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} are on their way to attack {FACTION}.

summaries.li: {FACTION} and {OTHERPEOPLE} asked the colony to witness their truce, and the colony said no.
{FACTION} and {OTHERPEOPLE} came to make a truce at the colony, and nobody of the colony came to witness it.
{FACTION} left {NAME} at the colony as a pledge of their truce with {OTHERPEOPLE}, and {NAME} came to harm there.

texts.li: The fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} who crossed the colony's land attacked {FACTION}. The truce made at the colony is broken, and the two peoples are at war with each other.

summaries.li: the truce {FACTION} and {OTHERPEOPLE} made at the colony was broken, and the two went to war.
the colony warned {FACTION} that fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} were coming to attack them, and the attack failed.
the colony turned back fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} at its gate, and the truce they made with {FACTION} at the colony held.
the colony fought off fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} at its gate, and the truce they made with {FACTION} at the colony held.

titles.li: No more truce at the colony

texts.li: [war] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and the colony has no more part in their truce with {OTHERPEOPLE}.
[destroyed] {FACTION} are gone, and their truce with {OTHERPEOPLE} is over.
[otherwar] {OTHERPEOPLE} are at war with the colony now, and the colony has no more part in their truce with {FACTION}.
[otherdestroyed] {OTHERPEOPLE} are gone, and their truce with {FACTION} is over.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony while their truce with {OTHERPEOPLE} was new.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone while their truce with {OTHERPEOPLE} was new.
[otherwar] {OTHERPEOPLE} turned against the colony while their truce with {FACTION} was new.
[otherdestroyed] {OTHERPEOPLE} were gone while their truce with {FACTION} was new.
nothing more came of the truce between {FACTION} and {OTHERPEOPLE}.
